9001.meaning2: noble person; who has attained higher wisdom

examples.text: akālacāriñ'hi sajanti saṅgā, akālacāriṃ puggalaṃ rāgasaṅg'ādayo aneke saṅgā sajanti parissajanti upaguhanti allīyanti. tasmā vikāle na caranti buddhā, tasmā ye catusaccabuddhā ariyapuggalā, na te vikāle piṇḍāya carantī'ti.
sabbe bālaputhujjanā jegucchā, puthujjanakalyāṇakaṃ upādāya aṭṭha ariyapuggalā ajegucchā'ti, appagabbho ajeguccho.

9002.meaning1: who has become noble; who has awakened

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe devappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe brahmappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe āneñjappattā viharanti, santi, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmiṃ bhikkhusaṅghe ariyappattā viharanti.

9003.meaning1: taught by the Noble One; preached by the Buddha

examples.text: dhammapīti sukhaṃ seti, vippasannena cetasā, ariyappavedite dhamme, sadā ramati paṇḍito.

9006.meaning1: realm of the noble ones; state of awakening
9006.commentary: (DHPa) dibbaṃ ariyabhūmin'ti evaṃ vīriyaṃ karonto rāg'ādīnaṃ malānaṃ nīhaṭatāya niddhantamalo aṅgaṇābhāvena anaṅgaṇo nikkileso hutvā pañcavidhaṃ suddh'āvāsabhūmiṃ pāpuṇissasī'ti attho.

examples.text: so karohi dīpam'attano, khippaṃ vāyama paṇḍito bhava, niddhantamalo anaṅgaṇo, dibbaṃ ariyabhūmiṃ upehisi.

9007.meaning1: what is called the realm of the noble ones

9008.meaning1: path of the noble ones; path to awakening; noble way

examples.text: yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo sammādiṭṭhi magg'aṅgaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.
niddā tandī vijambhitā, aratī bhattasammado, etena nappakāsati, ariyamaggo idha pāṇinan'ti.

9010.meaning1: developing the noble path; cultivating the path to awakening

examples.text: yā kho, bhikkhave, ariyacittassa anāsavacittassa ariyamaggasamaṅgino ariyamaggaṃ bhāvayato paññā paññ'indriyaṃ paññābalaṃ dhammavicayasambojjh'aṅgo sammādiṭṭhi magg'aṅgaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, sammādiṭṭhi ariyā anāsavā lok'uttarā magg'aṅgā.

9016.meaning1: making friends with noble ones; befriending awakened beings

examples.text: patirūpe vase dese, ariyamittakaro siyā, sammāpaṇidhisampanno, pubbe puññakato naro, dhaññaṃ dhanaṃ yaso kitti, sukhañ'c'etaṃ'dhivattatī'ti.

9017.meaning2: noble vehicle; vehicle of the nobles

9018.meaning1: noble community; (or) community of noble ones
9018.commentary: (DNt) ariyānaṃ saṅgho'ti ariyasaṅgho, ariyo ca so, saṅgho cā'ti vā ariyasaṅgho, taṃ ariyasaṅghaṃ.

examples.text: sugatassa orasānaṃ, puttānaṃ mārasenamathanānaṃ, aṭṭhannam'pi samūhaṃ, sirasā vande ariyasaṅghaṃ.

9019.meaning1: truth of the Buddha; noble truth
9019.commentary: (DNa) ariyasaccānan'ti ariyabhāvakarānaṃ saccānaṃ. (SNa) tasmā ariyasaccānī'ti yasmā tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni, tasmā ariyānaṃ saccānī'ti vuccanti. na hi vitathāni ariyā ariyasaccato paṭivijjhanti. (KHPa) ariyasaccānī'ti ariyāni saccāni, avitathāni avisaṃvādakānī'ti attho.

examples.text: tasmā evaṃ samannāgato bhikkhu iminā paramena sacc'ādhiṭṭhānena samannāgato hoti. etañ'hi, bhikkhu, paramaṃ ariyasaccaṃ yadidaṃ, amosadhammaṃ nibbānaṃ.
tapo ca brahmacariyañ'ca, ariyasaccāna dassanaṃ, nibbānasacchikiriyā ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.
avasesā ariyasaccakathā ṭhapetvā jāti-ādīnaṃ padabhājanakathaṃ visuddhimagge vitthāritāy'eva.

9021.commentary: (KHPa) ariyasaccānaṃ dassanaṃ ariyasaccānadassanaṃ, ariyasaccāni dassanan'ti'pi eke, taṃ na sundaraṃ.

examples.text: tapo ca brahmacariyañ'ca, ariyasaccānadassanaṃ. nibbānasacchikiriyā ca, etaṃ maṅgalam'uttamaṃ.

9022.meaning1: disciple of the noble ones; a noble disciple

examples.text: kittāvatā nu kho, āvuso, ariyasāvako sammādiṭṭhi hoti
idha, gahapati, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme suvinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme suvinīto na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati

9024.meaningLit: discourse on the disciple of the noble ones

examples.text: pañcahi, bhikkhave, vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhamānā ariyasāvikā ariyāya vaḍḍhiyā vaḍḍhati sār'ādāyinī ca hoti var'ādāyinī ca kāyassa. katamehi pañcahi?

9026.meaning1: noble in nature; distinguished in character
9026.meaning2: having the (moral) nature of a noble one, of sublime practice
9026.commentary: (MNa) catupārisuddhisīlena sīlavā. taṃ pana sīlaṃ ariyaṃ uttamaṃ parisuddhaṃ, ten'āha ariyasīlī'ti.

examples.text: samaṇo khalu, bho, gotamo sīlavā ariyasīlī kusalasīlī kusalena sīlena samannāgato
katamāni dve? ariyasukhañ'ca anariyasukhañ'ca. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

9032.meaning1: in the Buddha's training; in the discipline of the noble one

examples.text: ruṇṇam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ gītaṃ. ummattakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ naccaṃ. komārakam'idaṃ, bhikkhave, ariyassa vinaye yadidaṃ ativelaṃ dantavidaṃsakahasitaṃ.
maraṇañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, ariyassa vinaye yo sikkhaṃ paccakkhāya hīnāy'āvattati, maraṇamattañ'h'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, dukkhaṃ yaṃ aññataraṃ saṃkiliṭṭhaṃ āpattiṃ āpajjati.

9034.meaning2: practising the traditions of the noble ones, belonging to the noble tradition; who recites the Ariyavaṃsasutta

9035.meaning1: noble tradition; lineage of noble ones
9035.commentary: (DNa) ariyavaṃsā'ti ariyānaṃ vaṃsā. yathā hi khattiyavaṃso, brāhmaṇavaṃso, vessavaṃso, suddavaṃso, samaṇavaṃso, kulavaṃso, rājavaṃso, evaṃ ayam'pi aṭṭhamo ariyavaṃso ariyatanti ariyapaveṇī nāma hoti. so kho pan'āyaṃ ariyavaṃso imesaṃ vaṃsānaṃ mūlagandh'ādīnaṃ kāḷ'ānusāritagandh'ādayo viya aggam'akkhāyati. ke pana te ariyā yesaṃ ete vaṃsā'ti? ariyā vuccanti buddhā ca paccekabuddhā ca tathāgatasāvakā ca, etesaṃ ariyānaṃ vaṃsā'ti ariyavaṃsā. ito pubbe hi satasahassakapp'ādhikānaṃ catunnaṃ asaṅkhyeyyānaṃ matthake taṇhaṅ'karo medhaṅ'karo saraṇaṅ'karo dīpaṅ'karo'ti cattāro buddhā uppannā, te ariyā, tesaṃ ariyānaṃ vaṃsā'ti ariyavaṃsā.

examples.text: yo hi tattha dakkho analaso sampajāno paṭissato, ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, bhikkhu porāṇe aggaññe ariyavaṃse ṭhito.

9037.meaning1: way of living of the noble ones; sublime state
9037.meaning2: way of living of the noble ones; sublime state
9037.commentary: (DNa) ariyavāsā'ti ariyā eva vasiṃsu vasanti vasissanti etesū'ti ariyavāsā.

examples.text: dasa ariyavāsā. idh'āvuso, bhikkhu pañc'aṅgavippahīno hoti, chaḷaṅgasamannāgato, ek'ārakkho, catur'āpasseno, paṇunnapaccekasacco, samavayasaṭṭh'esano, anāvilasaṅkappo, passaddhakāyasaṅkhāro, suvimuttacitto, suvimuttapañño.

yañ'hi taṃ, bhikkhave, sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pi, ān'āpānassatisamādhiṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya, ariyavihāro iti'pi, brahmavihāro iti'pi, tathāgatavihāro iti'pī'ti.

9040.meaning1: of noble conduct; leading a noble life

examples.text: tath'eva khantisoraccaṃ, dhammā yasmiṃ patiṭṭhitā, ariyavuttiṃ medhāviṃ, hīnajaccam'pi pūjaye.
sagāravo sappaṭisso vinīto, apāpako adhisīle visuddho, so mātaraṃ pitarañ'c'āpi jantu, dhammena poseti ariyavutti.

9041.meaning1: noble mode of expression; communication with integrity

examples.text: aṭṭh'ime, bhikkhave, ariyavohārā. katame aṭṭha? adiṭṭhe adiṭṭhavāditā, asute asutavāditā, amute amutavāditā, aviññāte aviññātavāditā, diṭṭhe diṭṭhavāditā, sute sutavāditā, mute mutavāditā, viññāte viññātavāditā.

9044.grammar: masc gen pl of ariya, irreg form of ariyānaṃ
9044.commentary: (DNa) ariyāna subhāsitānī'ti tumhehi vuccamānāni buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ subhāsitāni.

examples.text: paccattaṃ veditabbo hi dhammo, sudesito cakkhumat'ānubuddho, ahañ'hi tumh'eva upāsamāno, sutvāna ariyāna subhāsitāni.

9045.meaning1: realm of the noble ones; (comm) middle region of India

examples.text: kathañ'ca, visākhe, ariy'uposatho hoti? upakkiliṭṭhassa, visākhe, cittassa upakkamena pariyodapanā hoti.

9047.meaning1: insulting a noble person; blaming an arahant

examples.text: yo so, bhikkhave, bhikkhu akkosako paribhāsako ariy'ūpavādo sabrahmacārīnaṃ, ṭhānam'etaṃ avakāso yaṃ so ekādasannaṃ byasanānaṃ aññataraṃ byasanaṃ nigaccheyya.

bhagavā taṃ turitaturitaṃ āgacchantaṃ disvā'va āvajjento aññāsi, ayaṃ aggasāvake akkositu'kāmo āgato'ti. sakkā nu kho paṭisedhetun'ti ca āvajjento, na sakkā paṭisedhetuṃ, theresu aparajjhitvā kālaṅ'kato ek'aṃsena padumaniraye nibbattissatī'ti disvā, sāriputtamoggallāne'pi nāma garahantaṃ sutvā na nisedhetī'ti vādamocan'atthaṃ ariy'ūpavādassa ca mahāsāvajjabhāva-dassan'atthaṃ mā h'evan'ti tikkhattuṃ paṭisedhesi.

9048.meaning1: wrong view of insulting a noble person

9049.meaning1: slandering the noble ones; finding fault with awakened beings
9049.meaning2: speaking ill of the noble ones, insulting the noble ones

examples.text: yaṃ musā bhaṇato pāpaṃ, yaṃ pāpaṃ ariy'ūpavādino, mittadduno ca yaṃ pāpaṃ, yaṃ pāpaṃ akataññuno, tam'eva pāpaṃ phusatu, yo te dubbhe sujampatī'ti.

9050.meaning1: Buddha's eight-part path; noble eight-fold path

examples.text: evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, ayaṃ dhammavinayo bahuratano anekaratano, tatr'imāni ratanāni, seyyath'idaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā, cattāro sammappadhānā, cattāro iddhipādā, pañc'indriyāni, pañca balāni, satta bojjh'aṅgā, ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo
ayam'eva ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo rūpanirodhagāminī paṭipadā, seyyath'idaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammāsaṅkappo sammāvācā sammākamm'anto sammāājīvo sammāvāyāmo sammāsati sammāsamādhi.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya.
passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, duṭṭha-aruko kaṭṭhena vā kaṭhalāya vā ghaṭṭito bhiyyosomattāya āsavaṃ deti.

9056.meaning1: collection of wounds; mass of sores

examples.text: passa cittakataṃ bimbaṃ, arukāyaṃ samussitaṃ, āturaṃ bahusaṅkappaṃ, yassa n'atthi dhuvaṃ ṭhiti.

9057.meaning1: like a mind with a running sore; mentally septic

examples.text: aruk'ūpamacitto puggalo, vijj'ūpamacitto puggalo, vajir'ūpamacitto puggalo. katamo ca, bhikkhave, aruk'ūpamacitto puggalo? idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya.

9059.meaning1: with open sores on the body

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya.
seyyathā'pi, māgaṇḍiya, kuṭṭhī puriso arugatto pakkagatto kimīhi khajjamāno nakhehi vaṇamukhāni vippatacchamāno aṅgārakāsuyā kāyaṃ paritāpeyya.

9060.grammar: fem, abstr, from na ruccati, neg

9061.meaning1: red light; reddish colour in the sky; rosy-fingered dawn
9061.commentary: (UDa) uddhaste aruṇe'ti uggate aruṇe, aruṇo nāma puratthimadisāya sūriyodayato puretaram'eva uṭṭhitobhāso.

examples.text: tatiyam'pi kho āyasmā ānando abhikkantāya rattiyā, nikkhante pacchime yāme, uddhaste aruṇe, nandimukhiyā rattiyā uṭṭhāy'āsanā ek'aṃsaṃ uttar'āsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena bhagavā ten'añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, aruṇ'uggaṃ. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi.
sikhissa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa aruṇo nāma rājā pitā ahosi. pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti.

9066.meaning1: name of the royal capital of king Aruṇavā
9066.meaning2: name of the royal capital of king Aruṇavā
9066.commentary: (APAa) aruṇavatiyā nagare'ti ā samantato ālokaṃ karonto uṇati uggacchatīti aruṇo, so tasmiṃ vijjatī'ti aruṇavatī, tasmiṃ nagare ālokaṃ karonto sūriyo uggacchatī'ti attho.

examples.text: pabhāvatī nāma devī mātā ahosi janetti. aruṇassa rañño aruṇavatī nāma nagaraṃ rājadhānī ahosi.
aruṇavatiyā nagare, ahosiṃ pūpiko tadā, mama dvārena gacchantaṃ, sikhinaṃ addasaṃ jinaṃ.
bhūtapubbaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā ahosi aruṇavā nāma. rañño kho pana, bhikkhave, aruṇavato aruṇavatī nāma rājadhānī ahosi.

9069.meaning2: lets the dawn arise, appear (while doing something); (carries on doing something) until dawn

9070.meaning1: name of a group of deities
9070.commentary: (DNa) sukkā karambhā aruṇā, āguṃ veghanasā sahā'ti ete sukk'ādayo tayo, tehi saha veghanasā ca āgatā.

examples.text: sukkā karambhā aruṇā, āguṃ veghanasā saha, odātagayhā pāmokkhā, āguṃ devā vicakkhaṇā.

9071.meaning1: first break of day; dawnrise; morning twilight

examples.text: sūriyassa, bhikkhave, udayato etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, aruṇ'uggaṃ. evam'eva kho, bhikkhave, bhikkhuno catunnaṃ ariyasaccānaṃ yathābhūtaṃ abhisamayāya etaṃ pubbaṅ'gamaṃ etaṃ pubbanimittaṃ, yadidaṃ, sammādiṭṭhi.

9072.meaning2: appearance of the reddish colour before sunrise

examples.text: taṃ atikkāmayato nissaggiyaṃ hotī'ti ekādase aruṇ'uggamane nissaggiyaṃ hoti.
nissaggiyaṃ hotī'ti saha aruṇ'uggamanā nissaggiyaṃ hoti.

9073.meaning1: with raw sores; with festering wounds

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, puriso arugatto pakkagatto saravanaṃ paviseyya. tassa kusakaṇṭakā c'eva pāde vijjheyyuṃ, arupakkāni gattāni vilekheyyuṃ. evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, puriso bhiyyosomattāya tatonidānaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvediyetha.
rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
aparā'pi, tisso taṇhā kāmataṇhā rūpataṇhā arūpataṇhā

9076.meaning1: formless state; formless phenomenon; formless attainment

examples.text: rūpehi, bhikkhave, arūpā santatarā'ti, ayam'ek'ānupassanā. arūpehi nirodho santataro'ti, ayaṃ dutiy'ānupassanā.
ye ca rūpe pariññāya, arūpesu asaṇṭhitā, nirodhe ye vimuccanti, te janā maccuhāyino'ti.

9078.meaning1: formless aggregate; i.e. feeling, perception, intention, and consciousness

examples.text: arūpin'ti ettha pana arūpakasiṇalābhiṃ, arūpakkhandhagocaraṃ vā'ti evam'attho daṭṭhabbo.

9079.meaning1: living in the formless realms; settled in an immaterial state

examples.text: ye ca rūp'ūpagā sattā, ye ca arūpaṭṭhāyino, nirodhaṃ appajānantā, āgantāro punabbhavaṃ.

9080.commentary: (DNa) rūpataṇh'ādīsu rūpabhave chandarāgo rūpataṇhā. arūpabhave chandarāgo arūpataṇhā. ucchedadiṭṭhisahagato rāgo nirodhataṇhā.

examples.text: aparā'pi tisso taṇhā, kāmataṇhā, rūpataṇhā, arūpataṇhā.
arūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante
mānuso'pi ca bhavo'bhirādhito, saggakāyam'agamaṃ sakiṃ sakiṃ, rūpadhātusu arūpadhātusu, n'evasaññisu asaññisuṭṭhitaṃ.

9082.meaning1: ripening in the formless realm; bearing fruit in the immaterial world

examples.text: arūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ, bhante.

9083.meaning1: connected with the formless realm; connected with formless meditation

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, sāmiso vimokkho? rūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho sāmiso vimokkho. katamo ca, bhikkhave, nirāmiso vimokkho? arūpappaṭisaṃyutto vimokkho nirāmiso vimokkho.

9084.meaning1: existence in the formless realm; immaterial being

examples.text: kati pan'āvuso, bhavā'ti? tayo'me, āvuso, bhavā, kāmabhavo, rūpabhavo, arūpabhavo'ti.
arūpadhātuvepakkañ'ca, ānanda, kammaṃ n'ābhavissa, api nu kho arūpabhavo paññāyethā'ti? no h'etaṃ bhante

9085.meaning2: whose thoughts are like a (tender) sore

9086.meaning1: passion for immaterial existence; desire for formless existence

examples.text: rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā, imāni pañc'uddham'bhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
pañca oram'bhāgiyāni saññojanāni, sakkāyadiṭṭhi, vicikicchā, sīlabbataparāmāso, kāmacchando, byāpādo. pañca uddham'bhāgiyāni saññojanāni, rūparāgo, arūparāgo, māno, uddhaccaṃ, avijjā.

9087.meaning2: world of the formless, immaterial realm

9088.meaning1: recognition of the formless; perception of immateriality; concept of the immaterial
9088.commentary: (MNa) yadi arūpasaññānan'ti iminā ākās'ānañc'āyatana-viññāṇañc'āyatana-saññā. itarehi pana dvīhi padehi samāpannakavāro ca asamāpannakavāro ca kathito'ti evam'etā koṭṭhāsato aṭṭha, atthato pana satta saññā honti. samāpannakavāro hi purimāhi chahisaṅgahito'y'eva.

examples.text: yā vā pan'etāsaṃ saññānaṃ parisuddhā paramā aggā anuttariyā akkhāyati, yadi rūpasaññānaṃ yadi arūpasaññānaṃ yadi ekattasaññānaṃ yadi nānattasaññānaṃ. n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanam'eke abhivadanti appamāṇaṃ āneñjaṃ.

9089.meaning1: percipient of the formless; not conscious of materiality
9089.commentary: (MNa) ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī'ti ajjhattaṃ na rūpasaññī, attano kes'ādīsu anuppādita-rūp'āvacara-jjhāno'ti attho.

examples.text: rūpī rūpāni passati, ayaṃ ekā disā, ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī bahiddhā rūpāni passati, ayaṃ dutiyā disā, subhan'tv'eva adhimutto hoti, ayaṃ tatiyā disā
ajjhattaṃ arūpasaññī eko bahiddhā rūpāni passati parittāni suvaṇṇadubbaṇṇāni, tāni abhibhuyya jānāmi passāmī'ti, evaṃsaññī hoti. idaṃ tatiyaṃ abhibh'āyatanaṃ.
vibhūtasaññino vuccanti ye catunnaṃ arūpasamāpattīnaṃ lābhino, na'pi so catunnaṃ arūpasamāpattīnaṃ lābhī'ti.

9091.meaning1: based on the formless; founded on the immaterial
9091.commentary: (ANa) arūp'ārammaṇan'ti arūp'āvacarajjhān'ārammaṇaṃ, yaṃkiñci arūpaṃ ārabbha uppajjanakaṃ vā'ti.

examples.text: katamāni dve? rūpārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ arūpārammaṇañ'ca sukhaṃ. imāni kho, bhikkhave, dve sukhāni.

9092.meaning1: related to the formless realm; belonging to the immaterial sphere

examples.text: tattha katamo āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro? kusalā cetanā arūp'āvacarā, ayaṃ vuccati āneñj'ābhisaṅkhāro.

9093.meaning1: meditation attainment belonging to the immaterial sphere

9094.construction:
na > a + √rūp + a + iya
arūpa + iya

examples.text: arūpiye vematiko, āpatti dukkaṭassa. arūpiye arūpiyasaññī, anāpatti.

9095.commentary: (VINa) rūpiye rūpiyasaññī'ti ettha sabbam'pi jātarūparajataṃ rūpiyasaṅgaham'eva gatan'ti veditabbaṃ.

examples.text: rūpiye vematiko rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ. rūpiye arūpiyasaññī rūpiyaṃ paṭiggaṇhāti, nissaggiyaṃ pācittiyaṃ.
arūpiṃ kho ahaṃ, bhante, attānaṃ paccemi saññāmayan'ti. arūpī ca hi te, poṭṭhapāda, attā abhavissa saññāmayo, evaṃ santam'pi kho te, poṭṭhapāda, aññā'va saññā bhavissati añño attā.
yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattā apadā vā dvipadā vā catuppadā vā bahuppadā vā rūpino vā arūpino vā saññino vā asaññino vā n'evasaññin'āsaññino vā, tathāgato tesaṃ aggam'akkhāyati arahaṃ sammāsambuddho.

avijjāsamphassajena, bhikkhave, vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa asmī'ti'pi'ssa hoti, ayam'aham'asmī'ti'pi'ssa hoti, bhavissanti'pi'ssa hoti, na bhavissanti'pi'ssa hoti, rūpī bhavissanti'pi'ssa hoti, arūpī bhavissanti'pi'ssa hoti, saññī bhavissanti'pi'ssa hoti, asaññī bhavissanti'pi'ssa hoti, n'evasaññī-n'āsaññī bhavissantipissa hoti.

9098.meaningLit: discourse on the self is formless

9099.meaning1: begone!; away with you!; what the hell!

examples.text: are bāla, brāhmaṇa, kiṃ tava ñātakā antaradvāre kahāpaṇaṃ ṭhapenti, parato maṃ harā'ti
